release_notes: Battle Calculator now supported from troop level 3 and upwards, also working in background mode

android.release_notes: TB Tools 1.0.3: Write to game is more reliable: it puts each number straight into the game's box and checks on the screen that it's there -- if not, it tries again another way, and tells you which troops didn't go in. On phones where the numbers didn't land (some Xiaomi phones) it now works. The attack report reading also stops sooner when your report has no higher monsters, or no troops of a type at those tiers.
